summary.text: Ben Christly is the Democratic candidate for the Washington House of Representatives, District 17-Position 1, in the November 3, 2026 general election, and is a Navy veteran and registered nurse.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he is an elected Clark County Charter Review Commissioner and listed education, small business, healthcare, housing, affordability and accountable government as his priorities.

paragraphs.text: Ben Christly served in the U.S. Navy and earned a bachelor's degree from Missouri State University.

In his survey answers, he said he enlisted at 17 and served as a hospital corpsman, then became a registered nurse and has worked in healthcare for more than two decades, including emergency care, care management and his current work as a flight nurse.
He also said he is a former small business owner and an endurance coach.
Christly said Washington has a constitutional responsibility to fully fund K-12 education and that the current funding formula should be reviewed.
He also said healthcare should be more affordable and accessible, and that the state should do more to support small businesses, including by reducing unnecessary red tape and improving permitting.
